title: incident: friend_request carrying a stale (expired) card is rejected loudly
description: June 9 friending incident (ea-claude-130): a raw invite is a frozen snapshot of a mutable identity — a friend request built from a stale card snapshot was 'dispatched successfully' to a DID no channel claimed and orphaned silently. spec-096 §C made card expiry ENFORCED (validateCard): a stale-but-validly-signed card must now fail loudly instead of orphaning mail. This fixture replays the stale-snapshot shape through the production inbound path: the envelope's signature verifies (the synthetic key is valid), then validateCard rejects the expired embedded card with card_expired, no contact is created, and the flight recorder logs the rejection.

source.note: identities and bodies are synthetic stand-ins; the card is re-signed by the synthetic sender with a deliberately past expires_at (the incident's frozen-snapshot class, sanitized)

body.note: synthetic reproduction: request built from a stale card snapshot
